records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Introductory Psychology
records.description: Survey of the basic terms, processes, principles, and theories related to the scientific study of human behavior.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Introduction to Addiction Studies
records.description: Analysis of cultural, societal, individual, and physiological factors underlying drug addiction.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Degrees and Careers in Psychology
records.description: Introduction to the major, degree requirements, resources for degree planning, graduate degrees, and careers for psychology majors. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Techniques in Stress Management and Mindfulness
records.description: An exploration of stress management and mindfulness practices. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Psychology as a Science
records.description: How psychology uses reasoning, skepticism, and the scientific method to evaluate claims made in everyday life.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Psychology of Happiness
records.description: Survey of topics in positive psychology with the focus being on a wholeness approach to well-being, examining both positive and negative experiences and empirically based strategies for cultivating one's own happiness.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Human Sexuality
records.description: Sexuality in personal development; personal, cultural, biological influences on sexual identification and behavior; fertility, reproduction, sexual functioning, sexuality and personality. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105. (Crosslisted course offered as PSYCH 230, WGSS 230.)

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Biopsychological Effects of Alcohol and Other Drugs
records.description: Biopsychological effects of the major classes of abused and psychotherapeutic drugs, including alcohol, stimulants, sedatives and hallucinogens. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105; BIOLOGY 102, BIOLOGY 107, or BIOLOGY 101 and 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Industrial Psychology
records.description: Job analysis and evaluation; personnel recruitment and selection; design and evaluation of training systems; performance appraisals. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Human Factors in Artificial Intelligence
records.description: Human-centered AI in work systems; organizational and ethical impacts of AI design and deployment. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Organizational Psychology
records.description: Employee motivation satisfaction and commitment; organizational communication; leadership; group behavior, teams and conflict; organizational change and development. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Diversity in Organizations
records.description: Psychology applied to cultural diversity in organizations; interpersonal and intergroup relationships; diversity training; EEO legislation and affirmative action. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Work, Stress, and Health
records.description: Workplace stressors and their effects on employee health, well-being, and safety; employee burnout, engagement, and stress management interventions. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Statistics in Psychology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: One of the following with a C- or better: ENGR 107, MATH 103 or higher, MGTOP 215, STAT 205, STAT 212, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 45%.
records.description: Descriptive statistics, probability, and inference; design and interpretation of research.  Recommended preparation:  PSYCH 105.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Research Methods in Psychology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: PSYCH 210; PSYCH 311 with a grade of C- or better.
records.description: Designing, conducting, and reporting research in selected areas of experimental psychology.  Recommended preparation:  PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Health Psychology
records.description: Psychological and physiological aspects of stress; health behavior and disease prevention; adjustment to chronic illness. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Personality
records.description: Theories, concepts, methods, discoveries in psychology of personality. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Psychology of Gender
records.description: Contemporary overview of the psychological theory and research on sex and gender.  Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105. (Crosslisted course offered as PSYCH 324, WGSS 324.)

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Principles of Self-Control
records.description: Theories and principles of self-control; factors contributing to successful self-control. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Behavior Modification
records.description: Analysis of behavior; application of behavioral principles to self-modification projects. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Fundamentals of Psychological Disorders
records.description: An introduction to psychological disorders, their diagnoses, contributing factors, and treatments.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Assessment and Treatment of Dual Diagnosis
records.description: Development of conceptual frameworks to guide the treatment and research of patient's co-occurring chemical dependency and psychiatric disorders.  Recommended preparation:  PSYCH 105.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Unparsed source wording: CoursePrerequisite:

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Forensic and Legal Psychology
records.description: Introduction to the ways in which psychological science is used to inform the legal system. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Social Psychology
records.description: Attitude changes, conformity, interpersonal relations, groups and social influences explored to give a coherent view of social psychology. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105 or SOC 101. (Crosslisted course offered as PSYCH 350, SOC 350.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Developmental Psychology
records.description: Introduction to biological and psychosocial influences on infant, child and adolescent development. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Psychology of Aging
records.description: Psychological processes of aging; changes in sensory, motor, cognitive, motivational and personality characteristics; research methodologies for the study of aging. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Biological Basis of Behavior
records.description: Functional relationship between nervous system and behavior; integrated organ systems, sensory processes, and investigative procedures. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105 or PSYCH 265; BIOLOGY 102, BIOLOGY 107, or BIOLOGY 101 and 105.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Sensation and Perception
records.description: Perception of size, depth, form, shape; illusions, contrast; historical and modern theories and research; applications and demonstrations. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 105.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Alcohol Use and Misuse
records.description: Biopsychosocial models of alcohol use and misuse; biology, effects, risk, and protective factors, assessment and diagnosis, and prevention of alcohol use and abuse disorders. Recommended preparation: PSYCH 210, 312.

records.subject: PSYCH
records.title: Multicultural Psychology
